summary.text: Tommy Wright is a Republican member of the Virginia House of Delegates, representing the 50th District since January 3, 2001.
The district covers Charlotte, Lunenburg and Mecklenburg counties and parts of Halifax and Prince Edward counties.
The House profile lists Tommy Wright's occupation as grocer (retired).

paragraphs.text: Tommy Wright was born in Richmond, VA.
The profile lists Victoria High School (1966) and a B.A. in Political Science from Old Dominion University (1970).

The profile lists Victoria Christian Church (trustee, elder), the Victoria High School Preservation Foundation (board of directors), the Lunenburg County Crime Solvers Association (charter member) and the Lunenburg County Rotary.
Tommy Wright serves on the Agriculture, Chesapeake and Natural Resources, and Communications, Technology and Innovation committees.
